roadmap: AI comment moderation — OpenAI Moderation API integration with fail-open, auto-flag, and admin review queue

phases.name: Auto-flag and Moderation Pipeline
phases.description: Add FLAGGED status, wire OpenAI Moderation API into comment creation, record audit events, extend admin review, add i18n feedback, and build admin flagged queue UI

steps.name: Prisma schema migration — FLAGGED, AUTO_FLAG, APPROVE
steps.description: Add FLAGGED to CommentStatus enum and AUTO_FLAG + APPROVE to ModerationAction enum in prisma/schema.prisma. Run prisma migrate dev. Additive-only migration (ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE). Zero downtime, no data loss. Previous app version tolerates new enum values at runtime.
acceptance_criteria: FLAGGED exists in CommentStatus enum alongside VISIBLE and HIDDEN
AUTO_FLAG exists in ModerationAction enum alongside HIDE, RESTORE, STATUS_CHANGE
APPROVE exists in ModerationAction enum alongside HIDE, RESTORE, STATUS_CHANGE, AUTO_FLAG
prisma migrate dev succeeds without data loss
Migration SQL contains only ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE statements (additive-only)
npm run build passes after schema change

steps.name: OpenAI moderation adapter — callOpenAIModeration + probeOpenAI
steps.description: Implement callOpenAIModeration and probeOpenAI in src/lib/openai-moderation-adapter.ts. Install openai npm package. callOpenAIModeration uses AbortController with 5s timeout and maxRetries=0. probeOpenAI makes one real moderation call at startup; non-blocking — logs warning on missing/invalid key or call failure, does not crash startup. Returns ModerationResult { flagged, categories }.
acceptance_criteria: callOpenAIModeration sends text to OpenAI Moderation API with 5s AbortController timeout
callOpenAIModeration uses openai SDK with maxRetries=0 (no SDK-level retries)
callOpenAIModeration returns ModerationResult { flagged: boolean, categories: string[] } on success
callOpenAIModeration throws on API error or timeout
probeOpenAI makes one real moderation call and returns true on success
probeOpenAI returns false and logs warning when OPENAI_API_KEY is missing
probeOpenAI returns false and logs warning when API call fails or times out
probeOpenAI does not crash the application on any failure
openai npm package is in package.json dependencies (Apache-2.0 license)
steps.scenario_name: Scenarios 4-6 (fail-open paths: timeout, 5xx error, missing API key)

steps.name: Domain function moderateText
steps.description: Implement moderateText in src/lib/openai-moderation.ts. Pure function receiving the adapter as a parameter (dependency injection per D6). Try/catch with fail-open: on adapter error, returns ModerationResult { flagged: false, categories: [] } and logs warning. Defines ModerationPort type for compile-time subtype enforcement at composition root boundary.
acceptance_criteria: moderateText is a pure function receiving text and adapter as parameters
moderateText calls the adapter and returns ModerationResult on success
moderateText catches adapter errors and returns { flagged: false, categories: [] } (fail-open)
moderateText logs a structured warning on adapter error (error message + context)
ModerationPort type is exported for compile-time enforcement
moderateText does not import the openai SDK or the adapter module directly
steps.scenario_name: WS-1 (clean comment VISIBLE with HTTP 201), WS-2 (toxic comment FLAGGED with HTTP 202)

steps.name: Wire moderation into comment POST route
steps.description: Modify src/app/api/ideas/[id]/comments/route.ts to call moderateText before prisma.comment.create. Import callOpenAIModeration adapter and pass it to moderateText. Branch on result: flagged -> status=FLAGGED + HTTP 202 + ModerationEvent with action=AUTO_FLAG and reason='auto_flag:<categories>'; clean -> status=VISIBLE + HTTP 201 (existing behavior); error -> status=VISIBLE + HTTP 201 + warning log (fail-open). Preserves existing validation, rate-limit, and auth logic.
acceptance_criteria: POST comment with clean text returns 201, status VISIBLE, no ModerationEvent created
POST comment with flagged text returns 202, status FLAGGED
POST comment with flagged text creates ModerationEvent with action=AUTO_FLAG
ModerationEvent.reason contains flagged categories in format 'auto_flag:hate,harassment'
POST comment when moderateText throws returns 201, status VISIBLE, warning logged
POST comment response body includes 'under review' message when flagged
FLAGGED comments do not appear in GET /api/ideas/[id]/comments responses (excluded by existing VISIBLE filter)
Existing rate limiting still enforced on comment POST (no regression)
Existing auth/validation logic preserved (no regression)

steps.name: Extend admin PATCH for APPROVE action and FLAGGED status
steps.description: Modify src/app/api/admin/comments/[id]/route.ts. FLAGGED->VISIBLE maps to APPROVE action (creates ModerationEvent with action=APPROVE). FLAGGED->HIDDEN maps to HIDE action (existing behavior, creates ModerationEvent with action=HIDE). Reject attempts to set status=FLAGGED via PATCH (FLAGGED is system-set only, per DIST-6). Existing HIDE and RESTORE flows preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Admin approving FLAGGED->VISIBLE creates ModerationEvent with action=APPROVE
Admin hiding FLAGGED->HIDDEN creates ModerationEvent with action=HIDE
Admin attempting to set status=FLAGGED via PATCH receives 400 error
Existing admin HIDE and RESTORE flows work unchanged (no regression)
Admin auth validation (validateAdminAuth) still required (no regression)
steps.scenario_name: Scenarios 12-14 (admin approve, admin hide, admin cannot set FLAGGED)

steps.name: i18n strings for moderation feedback
steps.description: Add Moderation.underReview keys to ro.json, hu.json, en.json. Used in 202 response body and frontend inline notice when a comment is flagged. Follows existing i18n namespace pattern (Moderation.* namespace).
acceptance_criteria: Moderation.underReview key exists in src/i18n/messages/ro.json
Moderation.underReview key exists in src/i18n/messages/hu.json
Moderation.underReview key exists in src/i18n/messages/en.json
All three translations are semantically accurate and culturally appropriate
Keys are referenced by the 202 response message in comment POST route
steps.scenario_name: i18n check (Moderation.underReview keys present in all locales)

steps.name: Admin flagged comments queue UI
steps.description: Add Flagged tab/filter to the admin page. Show comments with FLAGGED status including: comment text, idea title, author hash, flagged categories (parsed from ModerationEvent.reason field), and timestamp. Provide one-click Approve button (PATCH status=VISIBLE) and Hide button (PATCH status=HIDDEN). Flagged comments sorted newest-first. Count badge on Flagged tab showing number of pending flagged comments. Follows existing admin tab/filter pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Admin page has a Flagged filter/tab showing only FLAGGED comments
Each flagged comment displays: text, idea title, author hash, flagged categories, timestamp
Approve button changes status to VISIBLE and records APPROVE ModerationEvent
Hide button changes status to HIDDEN and records HIDE ModerationEvent
Flagged count badge updates after approve or hide action
Flagged comments are sorted newest-first
All visible UI strings come from locale files (no hardcoded text)
